package.name: airsim_nav_bridge
package.description: Sensor, clock and truth source that lets a ROS 2 navigation stack designed for a Gazebo world run on AirSim (Unreal Engine). It publishes the topics such a stack consumes (simulation clock, 3D lidar, barometer, magnetometer, ground truth) from the AirSim Python API, so the navigation package itself needs no change.
